info.sub_ename: DESIGN AND VERIFICATION OF QUALITY FOR MANUFACTURING PROCESS

description.sub_ename: DESIGN AND VERIFICATION OF QUALITY FOR MANUFACTURING PROCESS
description.describe_ch: 在產品與零件的開發過程中，如何設計製造過程的品質體系，使其滿足QUALITY-GATE PPK>1.67的要求，從而判定零件的合格性。同時滿足量產QUALITY-GATE CPK>1.33的要求，這是目前台灣企業最弱的管理技術。本課程的目的是培養具有零件及產品製造流程品質規劃和品質驗證能力的學生。本課程不同於以往的品質管理課程，著重於大量生產後品質的改進方法。透過本課程的學習，無論是產品開發的品質系統規劃，或是日常大量生產的品質控制，都可以幫助學生獲得日後在公司的專業技術能力。本課程也是企業高階主管或CEO必須具備的一門管理科學知識。
description.describe_eh: In the development process for parts and products, how to design the quality system of manufacturing process to meet the requirement of QUALITY-GATE of PPK>1.67, by which determines the qualification of parts. And at the same time to meet the requirement of the mass production’s QUALITY-GATE of CPK>1.33, which is currently the weakest management technology for Taiwanese companies. The purpose of this course is to cultivate students who possess the capabilities of planning and verification of quality for manufacturing process of parts and products. This course is different from previous quality management courses that focus on improvement methods for quality after mass production. Through the learning of this course, whether in quality system planning for product development or quality control for routine mass production, which can help students acquire professional and technical capabilities in the company in future. This course is also a management science knowledge that senior managers or CEOs who must possess in companies.
